scope: All 52 lot-labelled result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 412 grid for the 24 October 2005 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the date, states a total of 52 lots across 3 catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 lot identities reconcile to the secondary grid; 0 later result updates and 0 missing-type supplement are preserved from the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes 52 distinct lot labels exactly once and reports Offered: 52. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all 52 lot labels appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 52 and the secondary Offered: 52 denominator
